title: Octorato v8 kernel journal line
description: One line of ~/.claude/.cache/kernel/journal/<pid>.jsonl. Append-only and hash-chained: `prev` is the sha256 of the previous raw line (null on the first), `seq` counts from 0, and `start_ts` is copied forward on every line so a reader never seeks to the head. Every line stays under 4096 bytes (the POSIX atomic-append bound, docs/architecture/trace-storage.md); a line that would exceed it is truncated field by field and marked `trunc`. Written by scripts/kernel_proc.py; see docs/architecture/v8-kernel.md.

seq.description: 0-based position in this process's journal; the chain verifier asserts it increments by one

ts.description: unix seconds when the line was written

start_ts.description: unix seconds of this process's first line, copied forward so elapsed wall time is readable from any single line (Phase 3 quotas read it here)

pid.description: agent_id for a subagent, session_id for a main loop; sanitized to one path segment

kind.description: start: the process was registered. tool: a tool call passed the hot-path gate. exit: the process ended (Phase 1a-2). deny: a fail-closed gate, or the harness itself, refused a call (Phase 4). receipt: a v7 receipt mirrored by id (Phase 4). quota: a quota was breached (Phase 3). open: N calls ran unjournaled under OCTO_KERNEL_OPEN, backfilled once the journal was writable. release: an operator freed this process's lanes with `octo ps --release` (Phase 1b).

prev.description: sha256 of the previous raw line; null on seq 0

trunc.description: true when a payload field was shortened or dropped to stay under 4096 bytes; the core identity fields are never touched

ppid.description: parent pid; start lines of a subagent

type.description: agent_type, or 'main' for a main loop

worktree.description: enclosing git worktree root of cwd

dim_worktree.description: per-session worktree from connectome/sessions.json, when session isolation recorded one

tool_use_id.description: harness-supplied id; Phase 4 pairs a tool line with its deny line by this

input_sha256.description: sha256 of the tool input. The journal records the hash, never the content: the run stays verifiable, the payload stays in the harness transcript

count.description: open lines: how many calls ran unjournaled

ok.description: exit lines: the subagent finished without an error

tool_count.description: exit lines: how many tool calls this process journaled

seq_before.description: exit lines: seq of the last line written before this one, -1 when the exit line is the first

duration.description: exit lines: seconds between start_ts and the exit

spawn_tool_use_id.description: exit lines: the tool_use id of the Agent call that spawned this process, from the harness meta.json; named apart from tool_use_id because that one identifies the call a tool line describes

spawn_depth.description: exit lines: spawnDepth from the harness meta.json, how deep in the spawn tree this process sat

model.description: exit lines: the engine the child actually ran on, from the harness meta.json

agent_transcript_path.description: exit lines: the harness-written transcript of this subagent, the pointer a consumer re-verifies against

rule.description: deny lines: the registry rule id that refused the call. `kernel-replay` FAILS on a rule id that is in no registry/rules.yaml row: an unregistered deny is an orphan mechanism (RULE #1)

reason.description: deny lines: the refusal text shown to the model

source.description: deny lines: who refused. Absent means an Octorato gate; 'harness' means the runtime itself denied (PermissionDenied, documented for auto-mode denials only)

receipt_kind.description: receipt lines: the v7 receipt's own kind (seek, qa, gate-liveness)

receipt_sha256.description: receipt lines: sha256 of the ledger record. The journal mirrors a receipt's IDENTITY only, never its content: the receipt itself stays in ~/.claude/.cache/receipts, so the journal does not become a second copy of the ledger

receipt_ts.description: receipt lines: the ledger record's own ISO timestamp, kept apart from `ts` (when the mirror was written)
